SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH GRAM NEGATIVE BACILLI (OTHER THAN PSEUDOMONAS)

Administer parenteral therapy initially for approximately 1-2 weeks then can be converted to appropriate oral therapy.

Duration of treatment for 4 weeks depending on response

References:

- Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints
- Sanford keyword: Septic arthritis
- Up-to-date online
- Mathews CJ Lancet 2010 375:846
Therapy:
## Oral therapy to complete the course after intravenous therapy initially:

Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg PO BID ($) R

Non-VA order for above

Levofloxacin 500mg PO qday ($) R,DI

Non-VA order for above
